# premiere-autocut

> Adobe Premiere Pro 2022+ CEP panel + local Python engine (faster-whisper, MediaPipe, rapidfuzz) that auto-cuts silences, retakes (keeps the last take), mistake talk, fillers and script-reading moments from talking-head videos. Egyptian Arabic first, English supported. Non-destructive: builds a new sequence from subclips.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): features, install, usage
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo map, commands, data contracts, gotchas (read this before changing code)
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): pipeline and design decisions
- [Tuning](docs/TUNING.md): settings vs. symptoms

## Code
- [engine/analyze.py](engine/analyze.py): CLI entry point and defaults
- [engine/detectors.py](engine/detectors.py): detection primitives
- [engine/script_align.py](engine/script_align.py): script alignment
- [engine/plan.py](engine/plan.py): cut planning
- [jsx/host.jsx](jsx/host.jsx): Premiere ExtendScript (ES3)
- [js/main.js](js/main.js): panel logic
